paragraphs.text: Strategic Role: Globally recognized as the manufacturing, mechanical hulling, and export clearing center for Indian sesame seed, handling over 75% of national export volumes.

Key Facilities: Over 80 mechanized wet-hulling and optical laser-sorting processing plants located across Ahmedabad (Naroda, Sanand), Rajkot, Kadi, Gandhidham, and the Mundra SEZ; equipped with computerized continuous fluid-bed dryers, multi-stage trichromatic Sortex sorters, dry steam sterilizers (ETO replacement), and vacuum packaging lines.
Catchment Areas: Saurashtra and Kutch (Gujarat); vast interstate inflows arriving by road and rail from West Bengal (summer white crop) and Madhya Pradesh (Kharif white crop).

protection.name: Sesame Phyllody (Phytoplasma transmitted by Leafhopper / Jassid Orosius albicinctus)
protection.geography: National Epidemic Hazard (Devastating in all commercial belts)
protection.impact: Floral virescence; all floral parts (sepals, petals, stamens) are transformed into a bushy, green, leaf-like mass ("Witches' Broom" appearance); ovaries become elongated and leafy; plants become completely sterile with zero capsule or seed set; severe early infection causes 50–100% crop loss.
protection.passage: Sesamum — source table 174, row 2. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Sesame Leaf Webber & Capsule Borer (Antigastra catalaunalis)
protection.geography: All-India Commercial Belts (Heavy in Kharif and Summer)
protection.impact: Caterpillars web together terminal leaves and flower buds with silken threads, feeding inside; older larvae bore into tender stems, floral buds, and developing green capsules; chew holes in capsules and feed on ripening seeds; entrance holes collect brown frass; causes 20–50% yield loss.
protection.passage: Sesamum — source table 174, row 3. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Alternaria Leaf Spot & Blight (Alternaria sesami)
protection.geography: All-India Commercial Belts (Heavy in warm, humid spells)
protection.impact: Small, circular-to-irregular dark brown spots with concentric rings on leaves; lesions coalesce into large blights; spreads to stems and capsules, forming dark sunken cankers; leaves become brittle and shed prematurely (severe defoliation); capsules split prematurely with shriveled seeds.
protection.passage: Sesamum — source table 174, row 4. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Phytophthora Blight & Stem Rot (Phytophthora parasitica var. sesami)
protection.impact: Water-soaked brown lesions on lower stems and root collars; lesions turn dark brown-to-black, girdling the stem; leaves wilt, turn blackish-brown, and hang down on the stalk ("blighted appearance"); plants die in patches after heavy rains.
protection.passage: Sesamum — source table 174, row 5. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Bacterial Leaf Spot / Blight (Pseudomonas sesami, Xanthomonas sesami)
protection.impact: Water-soaked, translucent angular brown spots on leaves; spots turn dark reddish-brown with narrow chlorotic margins; systemic stem infection produces black longitudinal streaks; leaves drop prematurely.
protection.passage: Sesamum — source table 174, row 6. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Rust-Red Flour Beetle & Almond Moth (Tribolium castaneum, Cadra cautella)
protection.impact: Beetles and larvae penetrate stored seed bags; feed on broken seeds, increasing free fatty acid (FFA) levels and turning lipids rancid; moth larvae spin silken webs across seed surfaces.
protection.passage: Sesamum — source table 174, row 7. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.
